rawContent: @AP "If enacted, public co.'s in their annual reports & stock registration statements would have to report their greenhouse-gas emissions/#GHGs. The largest companies would also have to disclose emissions data related to their suppliers & reveal ... #climate-related risks" (1/3) 🌎🥳

@AP 🛑 #StopTheGOP who "insist #climate disclosures should remain voluntary ... Republican governors incl. TX Gov. Greg Abbott & AZ's Doug Ducey wrote that the rule ... would unduly penalize oil & gas co.'s.  ... Chamber of Commerce called the proposal overly prescriptive." (3/3 + 4)
